catalog.servicesIntro: Find the services of the Urban Commune of Mahajanga here and submit your request online from your personal space.

civil.title: Civil registry
civil.description: Birth, marriage and death certificates, legislation texts and miscellaneous documents issued by the Commune.

catalog.piecesNote: Indicative list: the Commune may ask for additional documents depending on your situation.

recette.title: Revenue
recette.description: Payment of taxes, fees, market stall dues and other municipal revenue, with follow-up of your situation.
pieces: National ID card or taxpayer identifier
Reference of the payment notice or tax concerned
Proof of the previous payment (for renewals)

transport.title: Transport
transport.description: Licences, authorisations and cards related to urban transport and parking within the Commune.

urbanisme.title: Urban planning
urbanisme.description: Building permits, planning certificates, works authorisations and alignments.
pieces: Title deed or proof of ownership of the land

marche.title: Market
marche.description: Allocation, renewal or transfer of a stall in the Commune's markets.
pieces: Nature of the activity carried out
Proof of payment of stall dues

cadastre.title: Land registry
cadastre.description: Land registry extracts, ownership certificates, boundary marking and plot transfers.
pieces: Plot reference or land title number
Plan or sketch of the plot

impot_foncier.title: Property tax
impot_foncier.description: Declaration, tax notice, payment certificate and claims related to property tax.
pieces: Tax reference or address of the property

naissance.title: Birth certificate
naissance.description: Copy or extract of a birth certificate issued by the Commune's civil registry.
pieces: Name, date and place of birth of the person concerned
Names of the parents, if known
Proof of kinship, if the request is made on behalf of someone else

mariage.title: Marriage certificate
mariage.description: Copy or extract of a marriage certificate issued by the Commune's civil registry.
pieces: Date and place of the marriage

deces.title: Death certificate
deces.description: Copy or extract of a death certificate issued by the Commune's civil registry.
pieces: Name of the deceased, date and place of death
Proof of relationship with the deceased

legislation.title: Legislation
legislation.description: Consultation and copies of municipal orders, deliberations and regulations.
pieces: Nature and reference of the text requested

actes_divers.title: Miscellaneous documents
actes_divers.description: Other documents and certificates issued by the Commune that do not fall under the headings above.
pieces: Precise description of the document or certificate wanted
Any supporting documents useful for the request
